prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: actual production key drawings for a 2D game sprite growth animation, not a concept illustration.
Primary request: redraw THREE corresponding full-object growth key poses of the same spore mushroom nest, fully covered by its long salmon mushroom canopy. The nest stays deeply covered at every stage and grows by two large discrete jumps. Output one clean transparent 3-column strip, 1536 by 512 pixels, each cell exactly 512 by 512.
Input roles:
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and exact size/position layout. Preserve its three widely separated size footprints and alignment. Its left, middle, right deeply-covered forms are SMALL, MEDIUM, ADULT.
Image 2 is the original approved level-2 design reference for palette, material, outline, and nest identity only.
Image 3 is the original approved adult level-3 design reference for palette, material, outline, and the adult identity only. All eggs and machinery stay completely hidden by the canopy in THIS strip.
Drawing: freshly render all three full cels consistently with one common deep hood construction: rounded high crown, long continuous downward salmon front and side walls, matching lower side curls with dark burgundy undersides, gently curved front hem almost touching the ground. The canopy wraps the front AND both sides and completely conceals the nest contents. A very thin ivory scalloped crescent is visible at ground level, just 6 to 10 pixels thick, with nearly all the cradle hidden. Do not expose eggs, stem, vents, ropes, wood, bellows, or mechanisms. Keep the same folds, silhouette proportions, perspective, light direction, and canopy orientation across all three drawings. Keep the full closed posture through growth.
Geometry is essential: first cell total object width about 322 px and height about 225 px; second width about 391 px and height about 273 px; third width about 474 px and height about 331 px. Each successive footprint is roughly 1.21 times wider AND taller, so each jump is obvious. Common local horizontal center x=256 and common lowest ground contact y=448. Left, middle, right global centers x=256, 768, 1280. Draw inside each cell without clipping. Preserve these relative sizes from image1; do not enlarge each object to fill its cell. No camera or perspective changes.
Style: match the supplied actual game art: warm coral/salmon softly painted mushroom surface, subtle broad highlights upper-left, maroon underside, smooth clean dark teal-black outer contour about 3 pixels at the target resolution, ivory organic scalloped cradle crescent. Consistent line thickness at all three sizes. Continuous intact artwork and clean generated alpha edges. Complete poses with no cut seams or detached fragments.
Background is genuinely transparent alpha. No cast ground shadow, no scenery, no text, no labels, no grid lines, no arrows, no effects, no glow, no motion blur. Three poses only. These are the actual closed hold states to be used as sprite keys.
